subject: Discovery recap & quick fit/timing check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@celestia.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & a quick fit check

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap from my side so we’re aligned and I don’t miss anything: 

- Primary use case: Reduce latency and TCO for interactive code-assistant queries in your developer portal (median context ~3k tokens).
- Success criteria you called out: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short queries, integration with your VPC, and predictable unit costs for 100k monthly active users.
- Proposed next step (from Redwood): short technical review with Ben to validate KV cache and VPC setup, followed by a 3-week pilot scoped to 1 GPU pod + traffic shaping.
- Timeline you mentioned: internal decision window targeting early Q4, but you wanted to validate fit first.

I attached a one-page recap and a loose pilot scope template for your review (redwood-discovery-recap.pdf). Two quick questions so I can prioritize on my side: 

1) How would you rate short-term priority for this (High / Medium / Low)?
2) If Medium/High, would a tightly scoped 3-week pilot make sense to validate latency and infra integration?

If it helps, I can send a short ‘what success looks like’ checklist for your infra team before Ben’s call. Are you free for a 15-minute sync next week? Here’s my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/marissa/15min

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (summary)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@celestia.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & a quick fit check

Hi Daniel —

Just circling back on my note below. I know priorities shift — would love a quick indicator so we don’t over-prepare on our side.

Short options: 
- "Not a fit" (totally fine, helpful either way)
- "Maybe later" (timeline?)
- "Pilot" (I’ll lock Ben in and share scope)

No pressure — 1 sentence is perfect.

Best,
Marissa

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 2:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted above)
From: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@celestia.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & a quick fit check

Hi Marissa —

Apologies for the delay — been heads-down on a product launch. Quick update from our side: after a brief internal sync this is lower priority than we anticipated for the September/October window. That said, the team sees potential if we can answer two items up front:

1) Ballpark cost for a 3-week pilot scoped as you described (1 GPU pod, up to 1M tokens processed) — order of magnitude is fine.
2) Data residency question: will logs/token traces ever leave our VPC during the pilot? We’re sensitive on auditability.

If you can share estimates and a short answer on residency, I’ll re-open with our infra lead and see whether we can fast-track.

Thanks,
Daniel Hsu
Director, Machine Learning Engineering
Celestia Inc.

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 9:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (bump)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@celestia.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & a quick fit check

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the update and totally understand the launch bandwidth. Quick answers below and I’ll send a short pricing note and pilot scope after this message: 

1) Ballpark for a 3-week scoped pilot (1 GPU pod, up to 1M tokens): roughly $18k–$25k depending on sustained throughput and KV caching configuration. We can tighten this after a short infra review with Ben.

2) Data residency during the pilot: For a Private/VPC deployment, logs and token traces remain in your VPC. For early hosted pilots we offer encrypted transit and configurable retention; we can also run the pilot in your VPC for full residency (Ben can validate network/home route requirements).

I attached a lightweight pilot-scope-template.xlsx that we typically use to align success criteria and test steps. If you’re willing, next steps I suggest: 
- 30-min technical sync with Ben (we’ll validate VPC connectivity and KV cache path)
- Finalize pilot scope and sign a short SOW (we’ll keep it limited to the pilot)

Ben — can you share 3 x 30-min slots next week for an infra deep-dive? Monica, adding you to keep CSM context for the pilot.

Daniel — if it’s easier, propose a single time and we’ll confirm. Otherwise I’ll share Ben’s availability tomorrow.

Appreciate the transparency here — whether you pause or move forward this is helpful context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: pilot-scope-template.xlsx
